title: 第56章 打的就是世界第三军事强国
content_zh:
第56章 打的就是世界第三军事强国-《文豪1978：从军旅作家开始》

列车行驶两天后，刘济民和九连的人被颠簸得晕头昏脑。刚开始连长马贵生还会在车上讲一讲战术，之后就只剩下聊天打盹，或者打牌了。
列车速度很慢，晚上火车一路往南，大站不停，白天偏僻支线停靠待命休息。加上因为调度问题，火车临时停靠偏僻小站的次数增多，导致转运所耗时间大大增加。
好在补给做得都很到位，白天都能吃上热食。保密性较高的车站，吃完饭还能在火车站内溜达溜达，趁着这个时间，可以训练一下新兵。
但是如果周围群众较多的话，所有人员不得打开车厢，不得下车，更不得与群众交谈。
想象一下，场站内，你在聊天，背后的闷罐车里装着一群年轻士兵。
幸亏不是夏天，要不然还没到桂省，就要出现非战斗减员了。
“老马，你们九连这次占大便宜了。”七连长看着正在跟战士谈心的刘济民，笑着说道。
“怎么了？”
“有这样一杆笔杆子，你们九连打一场胜仗，岂不是要被写出花来？”
“你可别瞎说，我们九连向来是实事求是。再说了，咱们是一个团的，什么你们我们，难怪说你们七连思想觉悟差，看来问题都出在你这个连长身上。”马贵生从七连长兜里掏出一根烟，放在鼻子前闻了闻后，笑着塞进嘴里，掏出火柴，先给七连长点上。
“不知道的，你他娘是政委呢。你猪鼻子插大葱，老母猪戴眼镜，冒充什么大学生。”七连长骂完后收起了笑容，问道：“你觉得真会打起来吗？”
“我又不是上级首长，不过看这个架势要打。”
“早就该拉开架势打一仗了，狗日的越南猴子太欺负人了。”副连长宋大根走了过来，摸着脑袋无所谓地说道：
“我家三代独苗，到了我这一代，我媳妇儿争气，生了俩。我这大根有了两个小根了，我是无所谓了，不就是打仗吗？还能怕了他越南人？唉，就是可怜我老娘，别哭瞎了眼！”
连长马贵生拍了拍宋大根的肩膀：“好样的兄弟！”
动员大会虽然已经召开，大军也已经南下，但究竟能不能打起来，许多人心里还在泛着嘀咕。
“登车！”随着命令下达，所有人迅速登车。
“指导员，越南说自己是第三军事强国，咱们打起来？”何小六支支吾吾地问道。

Two days after the train traveled, Liu Jimin and the people in the Ninth Company were dizzy from the jolts. At first, the company commander Ma Guisheng would lecture on tactics in the car, but after that he would just chat, take a nap, or play cards.
The train speed is very slow. At night, the train goes all the way south, non-stop at major stations, and during the day, it stops at remote branch lines to rest. In addition, due to scheduling problems, the number of temporary train stops at remote stations has increased, resulting in a significant increase in transfer time.
Fortunately, the supplies are in place and we can have hot food during the day. In a station with a high level of confidentiality, you can take a stroll inside the station after eating. You can take advantage of this time to train new recruits.
However, if there are many people around, no one is allowed to open the carriage, get out of the car, or talk to the people.
Imagine that you are chatting at the station, and there are a group of young soldiers in the stuffy tanker behind you.
Fortunately it's not summer, otherwise there would have been non-combat attrition before reaching Guangxi Province.
"Old Ma, your Ninth Company has taken a big advantage this time." The Seventh Company Commander looked at Liu Jimin who was having a heart-to-heart talk with the soldiers and said with a smile.
"What's wrong?"
"With such a pen, if you win a battle for nine consecutive years, won't you be written off?"
"Don't talk nonsense. Our Ninth Company has always been pragmatic. Besides, we are in the same regiment. What about you and us? No wonder your Seventh Company has poor ideological consciousness. It seems that the problem lies with you, the company commander." Ma Guisheng took out a cigarette from the Seventh Company Commander's pocket, put it in front of his nose, smelled it, put it into his mouth with a smile, took out a match, and lit it for the Seventh Company Commander first.
"I don't know, you're a fucking political commissar. You have a green onion in your pig's nose, and you're an old sow wearing glasses, so you're pretending to be a college student." After the seventh company commander finished scolding, he put away his smile and asked, "Do you think you can really fight?"
"I'm not the superior leader, but I'm going to fight this situation."
"It's time to get up and fight a long time ago. The stubborn Vietnamese monkeys are too bullying." Deputy company commander Song Dagen came over, touched his head and said nonchalantly:
"My family has only one child for three generations. When it comes to my generation, my daughter-in-law strives to have two children. My big root has two small ones. I don't care anymore. Isn't it just a war? How can I be afraid of the Vietnamese? Oh, you just pity my mother, don't cry blind!"
Company Commander Ma Guisheng patted Song Dagen on the shoulder: "Well done brother!"
Although the mobilization meeting has been held and the army has moved south, many people are still wondering whether a fight can start.
"Get on the bus!" As the order was given, everyone quickly boarded the bus.
"Instructor, Vietnam says it is the third military power, let's start a fight?" He Xiaoliu asked hesitantly.
